data.name: Amusement Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
In Amusement Tycoon, bring your dream amusement park to life! Build rides, shops, and decorations. Choose from a variety of attractions to create the perfect setting. Craft the ultimate park for your visitors.

Your park’s success hinges on your decisions. Hire and manage staff to keep everything running smoothly. Strategically set ticket and product prices, balancing profits with visitor happiness. Stay attuned to guest needs, maintain attractions, and ensure the fun never stops!

KEY FEATURES

  • ATTRACTIONS - Build a Ferris wheel, carousel, pirate ship, and much more to entertain your visitors.

  • SHOPS - Build establishments to sell food, drinks, and merchandise, keeping guest satisfaction high.

  • DECORATION - Customize your park with fountains, statues, and gardens to create unique environments.

  • STAFF MANAGEMENT - Assemble an efficient team to ensure flawless park operations.

  • STRATEGIC PRICING - Set ticket and shop product prices to maximize profits while keeping visitors engaged.

  • INVENTORY CONTROL - Manage your shops' supplies to prevent product shortages and keep sales flowing.

  • PARK MAINTENANCE - Keep your attractions in top condition for the safety and happiness of your visitors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 1030 (2 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB) or Intel UHD Graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB) or Intel Arc A750 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
